title: Apple Maps to power navigation experience for Ford UEV Platform
title_zh: 苹果地图将为福特UEV平台提供导航体验

paragraphs.en: Apple Maps to power the navigation experience for the Ford Universal Electric Vehicle Platform
paragraphs.zh: Apple Maps 将为福特通用电动汽车平台提供导航体验支持

paragraphs.en: Apple and Ford today announced that Apple Maps will be integrated directly into Ford’s upcoming Universal Electric Vehicle (UEV) Platform through Apple’s new MapKit for Automotive SDK. Coming to Ford’s UEV Platform in 2027, this integration will deliver a beautiful and easy-to-use navigation experience powered by Apple Maps directly to the vehicle’s displays. Road-level Maps information will also enable Ford’s Latitude AI team to build a seamless hands-free driving experience.
paragraphs.zh: 苹果和福特今天宣布，通过苹果全新的汽车版 MapKit SDK，Apple Maps 将被直接整合到福特即将推出的通用电动汽车（UEV）平台中。 这项整合将于 2027 年登陆福特的 UEV 平台，将借助 Apple Maps 提供美观且易于使用的导航体验，直接呈现在车辆屏幕上。 道路级地图信息还将帮助福特的 Latitude AI 团队打造无缝的免手持驾驶体验。

sents.en: Apple and Ford today announced that Apple Maps will be integrated directly into Ford’s upcoming Universal Electric Vehicle (UEV) Platform through Apple’s new MapKit for Automotive SDK.
sents.zh: 苹果和福特今天宣布，通过苹果全新的汽车版 MapKit SDK，Apple Maps 将被直接整合到福特即将推出的通用电动汽车（UEV）平台中。

sents.en: Coming to Ford’s UEV Platform in 2027, this integration will deliver a beautiful and easy-to-use navigation experience powered by Apple Maps directly to the vehicle’s displays.
sents.zh: 这项整合将于 2027 年登陆福特的 UEV 平台，将借助 Apple Maps 提供美观且易于使用的导航体验，直接呈现在车辆屏幕上。

sents.en: Road-level Maps information will also enable Ford’s Latitude AI team to build a seamless hands-free driving experience.
sents.zh: 道路级地图信息还将帮助福特的 Latitude AI 团队打造无缝的免手持驾驶体验。

paragraphs.en: Leveraging Apple’s new MapKit for Automotive SDK, Ford’s Universal Electric Vehicle Platform will offer drivers turn-by-turn directions using natural language, real-time traffic and incident information, intuitive search featuring detailed place cards, and routing options to help users easily find the best route to their destination. Additionally, Ford UEV drivers will benefit from an intelligent EV routing functionality, including battery preconditioning. Ford will also use road-level information from Apple Maps as part of the development of its next-generation BlueCruise hands-free highway driving capability to deliver a more seamless on-ramp-to-off-ramp experience.
paragraphs.zh: 借助苹果全新的 MapKit for Automotive SDK，福特的通用电动汽车平台将为驾驶员提供自然语言引导的逐条路线指示、实时交通和事故信息、包含详细地点卡片的直观搜索功能，以及多种路线选择，帮助用户轻松找到前往目的地的最佳路线。 此外，福特通用电动汽车平台的驾驶员还将受益于智能电动汽车路线规划功能，包括电池预调节功能。 福特还将在开发下一代 BlueCruise 免接管高速公路驾驶功能时，利用苹果地图的道路级信息，以提供更无缝的从入口到出口的整体驾驶体验。

sents.en: Leveraging Apple’s new MapKit for Automotive SDK, Ford’s Universal Electric Vehicle Platform will offer drivers turn-by-turn directions using natural language, real-time traffic and incident information, intuitive search featuring detailed place cards, and routing options to help users easily find the best route to their destination.
sents.zh: 借助苹果全新的 MapKit for Automotive SDK，福特的通用电动汽车平台将为驾驶员提供自然语言引导的逐条路线指示、实时交通和事故信息、包含详细地点卡片的直观搜索功能，以及多种路线选择，帮助用户轻松找到前往目的地的最佳路线。

sents.en: Additionally, Ford UEV drivers will benefit from an intelligent EV routing functionality, including battery preconditioning.
sents.zh: 此外，福特通用电动汽车平台的驾驶员还将受益于智能电动汽车路线规划功能，包括电池预调节功能。

sents.en: Ford will also use road-level information from Apple Maps as part of the development of its next-generation BlueCruise hands-free highway driving capability to deliver a more seamless on-ramp-to-off-ramp experience.
sents.zh: 福特还将在开发下一代 BlueCruise 免接管高速公路驾驶功能时，利用苹果地图的道路级信息，以提供更无缝的从入口到出口的整体驾驶体验。

paragraphs.en: “Apple Maps delivers the best map experience in the world, and we’re excited to bring the power of Maps’ navigation technology to Ford’s innovative Universal Electric Vehicle Platform,” said Eddy Cue, Apple’s senior vice president of Services and Health. “With our new MapKit for Automotive SDK, we’re bringing Maps further into drivers’ daily lives, giving them an incredibly accurate and easy-to-use navigation system that is seamlessly integrated into Ford vehicles.”
paragraphs.zh: “Apple Maps 提供了全球最佳的地图体验，我们很高兴能将 Maps 导航技术的强大功能融入福特创新的通用电动汽车平台，”Apple 服务与健康高级副总裁 Eddy Cue 表示。“通过我们全新的 MapKit for Automotive SDK，我们将进一步将 Maps 融入驾驶员的日常生活，为他们提供一个极其精准且易于使用的导航系统，并与福特汽车无缝集成。”

paragraphs.en: “Our new midsize electric vehicle will be priced around $30,000 and redefines what advanced technology can be — simple, useful, and truly attainable for more customers,” said Jim Farley, Ford Motor Company’s CEO. “We’re proud to embed Apple Maps’ navigation and mapping technology directly into our Universal Electric Vehicle Platform, giving customers the ultimate navigation experience alongside our Ford app, a full suite of software, and next-generation BlueCruise, all enabled by a new zonal architecture. Apple Maps has delivered a world-class product, and we’re honored to be among the first to embed it directly into a vehicle, helping define intuitive, capable driving.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们全新的中型电动汽车价格将在 3 万美元左右，它将重新定义先进技术可以多么简单、实用且真正为更多消费者所拥有，”福特汽车公司首席执行官吉姆·法利表示。“我们很自豪能将 Apple Maps 的导航和地图技术直接集成到我们的通用电动汽车平台中，从而在福特应用程序、完整的软件套件以及新一代 BlueCruise 的基础上，为客户提供终极的导航体验——这一切都得益于全新的区域架构。” “Apple Maps 已经打造出一款世界级的产品，我们很荣幸能成为首批将其直接集成到汽车中的企业之一，这有助于塑造直观且功能强大的驾驶体验。”

sents.en: “Our new midsize electric vehicle will be priced around $30,000 and redefines what advanced technology can be — simple, useful, and truly attainable for more customers,” said Jim Farley, Ford Motor Company’s CEO. “We’re proud to embed Apple Maps’ navigation and mapping technology directly into our Universal Electric Vehicle Platform, giving customers the ultimate navigation experience alongside our Ford app, a full suite of software, and next-generation BlueCruise, all enabled by a new zonal architecture.

sents.en: Apple Maps has delivered a world-class product, and we’re honored to be among the first to embed it directly into a vehicle, helping define intuitive, capable driving.”
sents.zh: “Apple Maps 已经打造出一款世界级的产品，我们很荣幸能成为首批将其直接集成到汽车中的企业之一，这有助于塑造直观且功能强大的驾驶体验。”

paragraphs.en: This integration is made possible by Apple’s new MapKit for Automotive SDK, which allows automakers to embed and customize Apple Maps. The SDK also enables automakers to deliver a cohesive navigation experience for drivers that is consistent with the look and feel of their vehicles, and provides road-level information to help automakers build hands-free driving experiences. The SDK follows the same privacy principles that the Apple Maps app provides today. Apple does not collect users’ location details and activity on the vehicle’s map in a way that can be tied back to the individual user.
paragraphs.zh: 这种整合得益于苹果全新的 MapKit for Automotive SDK，它允许汽车制造商嵌入和定制 Apple Maps。 该 SDK 还使汽车制造商能够为驾驶员提供与车辆外观和体验相一致的无缝导航体验，并提供道路级信息，帮助汽车制造商构建免手持驾驶体验。 该 SDK 遵循了 Apple Maps 应用目前所采用的相同隐私原则。 苹果不会以能够追溯到具体用户的方式收集用户在车辆地图上的位置详情和活动信息。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the integration of Apple Maps into Ford’s UEV Platform, CarPlay will continue to be available on Ford vehicles, providing drivers with a safe and smart way to use their iPhone in the car.
paragraphs.zh: 除了将 Apple Maps 整合到福特的 UEV 平台之外，CarPlay 也将继续适用于福特汽车，为驾驶员提供了一种在车内安全、智能地使用 iPhone 的方式。
